tests.name: ros
tests.command:
source portable_deps/litchi_hardware/ros2/install/setup.bash
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=199 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/adapters/pico/src:$PWD/ros_ws/src/teleop_core:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
portable_deps/litchi_hardware/.pixi/envs/ros2/bin/python -m pytest adapters/litchibot --ignore=adapters/litchibot/test_cli.py portable_deps/litchi_hardware/ros2/src/manus_sharpa_teleop/manus_sharpa_teleop/test portable_deps/litchi_hardware/ros2/src/sharpa_hand/sharpa_driver/test -q --tb=short

notes: Groups overlap; counts are not a unique-test total.
Host skips ROS-only tests; ROS group runs them in domain 199.
GUI tests use isolated /tmp/gello-full-gui-tests virtualenv with existing base PySide6.
Physical SDK loader spies, fake Sharpa, synthetic source, stub arm/hands wrappers only.
Production Docker/FR3/glove/hardware stack not launched; real acceptance pending.
